prompts.name: sdpm-spec
prompts.description: Shape a deck together in dialogue — audience, message, outline — before it is built (spec mode).

arguments.name: topic

arguments.name: brief
arguments.description: The look you want, a brand, or a reference — anything to start from.

prompts.description: Translate an existing deck into another language as a sibling deck.

arguments.name: deck_id
arguments.description: Path (or ID) of the deck to translate.
